mapping.claudeDescription: Route Claude Code without changing model names in the client. Placeholders like sonnet or fable rewrite on /v1/messages.
mapping.codexDescription: Route Codex CLI without changing model names in the client. GPT codenames like gpt-sol or gpt-terra rewrite on /v1/chat/completions and /v1/responses.
mapping.cursorDescription: Map Cursor model IDs (e.g. claude-4.5-sonnet) to tproxy virtual models. Add only the pairs you need — rewrites apply on /v1/chat/completions. Requires a public/tunnel URL.
mapping.claudeTierDesc: Map each Claude tier placeholder to a virtual model ID or a provider:upstream-model selector. Env vars such as ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL override config when set on the tproxy process.
mapping.codexTierDesc: Map each Codex GPT codename (gpt-sol, gpt-terra, gpt-luna) to a virtual model ID or a provider:upstream-model selector. Codex does not use Claude tier names like sonnet.
